insight.title: Why the most beautiful paths are the narrowest
insight.subtitle: The quiet art of choosing what to leave behind.

sections.text: Every morning, the world presents us with a thousand open doors. We often think success comes from trying to walk through all of them at once. But true momentum begins with a single, deliberate turn of a key. It is the brave decision to leave most rooms behind to find the one that matters.

Strategy is the quiet hand that clears the table. It is not a search for more, but a practice of subtraction. Like a sculptor finding the shape inside a stone, a great plan removes the distractions. It aligns every hand and every heart toward one clear horizon, turning scattered light into a focused beam.

When we choose well, the world feels lighter. We no longer chase every passing shadow. Instead, we move with a steady, quiet confidence. Business strategy is simply the story of how we spend our precious time. By narrowing our gaze, we finally gain the power to build something that lasts, beautiful and true.
